references.text: Moses gave an order to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh to fight alongside the other tribes before they could return to their land east of the Jordan.
Moses reminds the tribes east of the Jordan of their duty to help their brothers take possession of the land before returning to their own inheritance.
Joshua reminds Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh of Moses' command that they should help the other tribes take possession of the land.
The Reubenites, Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh crossed the Jordan armed at the head of the Israelites, just as Moses had commanded them.
Moses is referred to as the servant of the Lord, the same expression used in this verse.
Moses is called the servant of the Lord, the same title used here.
The children of Gad and Reuben promise to do as Moses commands and cross the Jordan to fight.
